title: Overlapping queue histories
contract: Completed enqueue(1) and dequeue operations must admit a FIFO linearization respecting response-before-invocation order; under atomic execution at chosen linearization points.
scope: Four valid event permutations for one enqueue and one dequeue plus two additional schedules (six total); atomic profile admitted; empty queue initially.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: A proposed linearization respects real-time precedence.
Observed dequeue result is permitted by some legal FIFO linearization.

variants.description: Always return empty even after enqueue completed.
Linearize at invocation rather than response.
